parts.prompt:
The radius of a circular stain is increasing at 0.37 centimeter per minute. When the radius is 5.2 centimeters, how fast is its area increasing, to the nearest tenth?

A. 1.9 cm²/min
B. 3.8 cm²/min
C. 10.1 cm²/min
D. 12.1 cm²/min
